title: Get workflow inputs
description: List editable run inputs using opaque field IDs. Call before execution when a workflow may require form values.

workflowId.description: Opaque workflow identifier returned by dsagent.workflows.list.

inputSchema.description: Workflow whose editable run-time fields should be inspected.

workflowId.description: Workflow whose run-time fields were inspected.

fields.description: Editable workflow fields; use writable field IDs in dsagent.execution.run.fieldValues.

fieldId.description: Opaque field identifier accepted by dsagent.execution.run.

fieldType.description: Workflow field type; upload-file fields are not writable through MCP.

value.description: Current bounded field value, or an empty value for unsupported upload-file inputs.

writable.description: Whether MCP may provide a replacement value for this field.

outputSchema.description: Editable run-time fields for one workflow.
